meaning: The Milky Way's star dots at every zoom: the galaxy-wide tracers, then the nested levels around the Sun, each adding dots as its region fills the view.
basis: Presentation choice: each level starts to appear when the view's half-width at the Sun shrinks to the level's radius, so its edge is off screen, and is whole when it reaches the next level's radius; the 20 pc census is whole at 5 pc. The galaxy level is drawn whole within 10 kpc, as before. The sky level appears as the view narrows from 5 pc to 0.05 pc (10,000 AU), where the view from just outside the Solar System is a sky of stars.
